name: odysseus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Cereysus instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Cereysus tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Cereysus through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Cereysus Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cereysus only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
